name: ANNA GIOANNA MALETTA
bioAdditions: Anna Giovanna was born on 5 June 1666, daughter of Giuseppe Maletta and Vincenza Castagnaro (S1). She married Antonino Cicco on 5 October 1681, aged 15 (S2).
